corpus_version_method: collect_corpus(repository_root) with default include/exclude; compute_corpus_version(chunks). JSON questions/reports are not ingested.

questions.question: What does collect_corpus include by default, and which chunker handles each suffix?
questions.answer_summary: Visible .md and .py files; Markdown uses chunk_document and Python uses chunk_python_code.

questions.question: How does compute_corpus_version bind source identity into its version?
questions.answer_summary: Sort chunks by path/start line, serialize doc_id values, SHA256, take the first 16 hex characters.

questions.question: Which function creates the knowledge_search tool package and what corpus version does it require?
questions.answer_summary: knowledge_package requires a nonempty string corpus_version supplied by the host.

questions.question: What source path checks does SourceAccess.read apply before reading bytes?
questions.answer_summary: Reject malformed paths, traversal, excluded/nonincluded sources, and aliases.

questions.question: How does chunk_document split Markdown sections that exceed max_lines?
questions.answer_summary: It applies fixed-size overlapping chunks with base line offsets and preserves the section title.

questions.question: How does MockEmbedding.embed deterministically turn a text into a vector?
questions.answer_summary: SHA256 bytes mapped to floats in [-1,1], truncated or zero padded to the configured dimension.

questions.question: What does retrieve return and how does min_score filter results?
questions.answer_summary: Evidence objects; distances above the threshold are discarded.

questions.question: Why can moving or renaming a source file change the corpus version even if its text is unchanged?
questions.answer_summary: doc_id includes the path, range, and text hash; the version hashes these identities.

questions.question: Why are hidden directories and credential-like files unavailable as knowledge sources?
questions.answer_summary: excluded_path denies hidden components and mandatory credential patterns.

questions.question: Does installing a tool package itself grant filesystem or command permissions?
questions.answer_summary: No; capability assembly composes tools without granting permissions.

questions.question: How are stale or forged retrieval citations detected before knowledge_search returns evidence?
questions.answer_summary: Read current bytes and compare exact lines, hash, doc_id and range; invalid results are skipped.

questions.question: Are smaller or larger retrieval scores better in this RAG implementation?
questions.answer_summary: Scores are Chroma distances, so lower is better.

questions.question: How are source line numbers preserved when fixed-size chunks start partway through a document?
questions.answer_summary: The helper adds base_line to local offsets and moves forward by max_lines minus overlap_lines.

questions.question: Why is Mock embedding useful for offline plumbing checks but not evidence of semantic retrieval quality?
questions.answer_summary: It uses text hashes rather than a semantic model; no external API is needed.

questions.question: How do RAG_EMBEDDING_DIMENSION and RAG_EMBEDDING_BASE_URL reach the OpenAI client in the build script?
questions.answer_summary: RAGConfig.from_env reads them; the build script forwards both; OpenAIEmbedding configures the client and request.

questions.question: How does corpus ingestion share the knowledge tool source visibility policy?
questions.answer_summary: collect_corpus constructs SourceAccess; the package also reads sources through its bound SourceAccess.

questions.question: How is a chunk citation created and then checked against current file content?
questions.answer_summary: Chunk.citation uses path and inclusive lines; knowledge_search verifies current content, hash and identity.

questions.question: How are Chroma metadata and distances converted into evidence for the knowledge tool?
questions.answer_summary: VectorIndex.search formats results, retrieve creates Evidence objects, and the tool validates those sources.

questions.question: How is the application knowledge tool registered as a harness capability extension?
questions.answer_summary: knowledge_package returns ToolPackage with an install callback; assemble_capabilities invokes it and records the contract.

questions.question: What links corpus version hashing with the immutable knowledge package recovery contract?
questions.answer_summary: compute_corpus_version hashes chunk identities; the host passes the version into the knowledge package binding.

questions.question: How does the query script pass endpoint and dimension settings to the embedding provider?
questions.answer_summary: It reads RAGConfig.from_env and forwards embedding_dimension and embedding_base_url.

questions.question: Is the old claim that applications/project_assistant does not exist still valid?
questions.answer_summary: No. The handoff explicitly retracts that claim and the corpus module is implemented.

questions.question: The handoff says OpenAIEmbedding is fixed at 1536 dimensions. Is that current behavior?
questions.answer_summary: No. Configuration can request dimensions, otherwise the first response determines them; known defaults are pre-response fallbacks.

questions.question: The handoff lists no embedding endpoint or dimension environment variables. Is that list complete now?
questions.answer_summary: No. RAGConfig.from_env reads RAG_EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS (with RAG_EMBEDDING_DIMENSION as an alias) and RAG_EMBEDDING_BASE_URL.

questions.question: The handoff says retrieval evaluation is unimplemented. Is there now an offline evaluator?
questions.answer_summary: Yes. An evaluator now computes recall and reciprocal rank, and the script builds a fresh index and report.

questions.question: The application README describes Mock embedding as hash plus random projection. Does the code use a random projection?
questions.answer_summary: No. It maps SHA256 bytes directly to floats and pads zeros.

questions.question: Does the progress recovery goal mean git commit history is already part of the default corpus?
questions.answer_summary: No. The handoff marks it unimplemented, and collection accepts visible Markdown/Python while excluding .git.

questions.question: Has the default harness built-in tool package list already acquired a Project Assistant knowledge package?
questions.answer_summary: No. Built-ins remain coding, memory and shared-memory; knowledge is an application extension.
